lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments identified across the lateral torso. Spacing is wider in the mid-section (approx. 5-7% of torso width) and more compressed in the posterior region (approx. 3-4% of torso width).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second anterior line, splitting at the dorsal ridge. A minor merging of lines occurs on the upper haunch where the 10th and 11th lines converge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 terminates prematurely at the shoulder-neck junction. Line 8 is segmented into two distinct dashes, and Line 11 is composed of fragmented dots rather than a continuous line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct white spots is visible on the mid-to-lower haunch, situated between the final vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-connected horizontal dash approximately 15% the length of the adjacent vertical line.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white crescent patch is visible on the lower ventral neck. White 'chevron' markings are visible between the eyes and on the bridge of the muzzle. Dark pelage on the lower limbs creates a high-contrast 'sock' appearance.
